correctness.rationale: In the affine chart of the empty minor the principal-minor coordinates are Δ_I(A). Scaling a symmetric matrix by A ↦ DAD, with D=diag(z^(2^(i−1))), induces the weight 2Σ_{i∈I}2^(i−1) on Δ_I. The action preserves the closure and the subset-sum weights are distinct, so the ambient projective fixed points are exactly the 2^n coordinate lines. The image of diagonal A is the dense affine chart of the Segre product of n projective lines: its coordinates are ∏_{i∈I}a_ii. Its closure therefore contains every coordinate line; equivalently, the stated homogeneous degeneration has the unique least exponent at the selected subset. Localization gives χ_top(Z_n)=2^n, and compactly supported additivity gives zero for the ambient complement. For the dimension, the first and second minors recover all diagonal entries and the squares of every off-diagonal entry, so the affine chart map has finite fibers and its image closure has dimension n(n+1)/2. No extra smoothness assumption is needed. The finite tests described in VERIFICATION.md were not rerun.
